verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is positioned as a complete double-entry accounting system meant to replace QuickBooks. Its Command AI assistant can take on work like 'writing journal entries', so journal entries clearly exist in the ledger. However, no evidence shows an accountant-facing manual journal entry screen with enforced debit/credit balancing and memo fields; transaction-level notes are only mentioned for syncing to external ledgers. Missing for 10: documented manual journal entry UI, balanced debit/credit validation, memo/attachment support on journal entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
